purpose: Backend variant of the registered protocol physical-p4-kleak-dense for the Cells backend gpu (L4): same case, observables, phases, mapping and tolerance derivation, plus measured backend terms (tolerance_derivation.backend_terms). The registered purpose follows. Rung 4 (P4, network ion channels): judge Cells' own physics (resolved_pump_tissue@3 with one kleak_always_open@1 population per membrane (P = 6e-18 / 7.5e-9 = 8e-10 m/s), abundance 1) on the rung-1 mammal default world against the plain-BETSE case parity-rung2-4-20261109-01/betse-reference/p4-kleak-dense (general network with only these channels, no biomolecules). Tolerances by the rung-1 v2 method; Cells-only terms from blind @3 runs at 1 ms and 0.5 ms INIT (field solver @3).

tolerance_derivation.method: 3 x (sum of measured difference terms), rounded up to one significant figure; per ion for concentrations (a zero sum gets the floor 1e-12)

backend_terms.rule: new sum = registered sums_before_margin + these terms; new tolerance = max(registered tolerance, 3 x new sum rounded up to one significant figure, floor 1e-12)

cells_cpu_vs_l4_backend.role: judged CPU run vs blind L4 run A

cells_l4_run_to_run.role: blind L4 run A vs blind L4 run B

observable_mapping: BETSE vm in this world is cell charge / (cm * sum mem_sa), uniform within a cell (Phi_b = 0; v_env not subtracted; sim.py:2029). Cells vm_ave = Q_cell / sum C_patch with C_patch = cm * mem_sa, broadcast to membranes for vm. Patch voltages and exterior potentials are diag_* arrays, reported only. Boundary-ring ECM sites are excluded: BETSE resets them each step, the resolved model holds them as reservoirs.
notes: Reported only: venv_time (BETSE's screened, smoothed estimate has no Cells counterpart) and Cells diag_* arrays.
Gate open fraction is not in the comparison layout and is not judged.

Emulator terms reused from parity-rung2-4-20261109-01/emulator-01 (BETSE-order kernel, unaffected by the field solver); the network runner reproduces those runs from this snapshot (emulator-01/p4kv-dt1_vs_20261109-01.json).

L4 variant (parity-l4-20261111-01): backend terms from the judged CPU run of physical_p4_kleak_dense.json (/mnt/workspaces/Cells/parity-rung2-4-20261109-03/p4k/run/layout) and two blind L4 runs (/mnt/workspaces/Cells/parity-l4-20261111-01/blind-A/p4-kleak/run, /mnt/workspaces/Cells/parity-l4-20261111-01/blind-B/p4-kleak/run) from snapshot c819a4e41e5f61829ee604cfc3081f75408c0da2; the backend term also contains any engine difference between the two snapshots (the engine commits in between are recorded as leaving default trajectories unchanged).
L4 runs are not bitwise reproducible run to run; cells_l4_run_to_run measures that.

cells_run.note: @3 IMEX ARS(2,2,2) with exponential stage gates (exponential_mean_rate_linear_target_gates@1); field solver @3 because @2 refuses the pinned 0.5 ms runs at its rounding floor. Judged runs on CPU; the Cells-only terms were measured on the L4 (blind-01), which differs from CPU only at rounding level
cells_run.mapping: network_world_adapter.py run-resolved (NETWORK_RESOLVED): one population per membrane patch and network channel, Kv1p5 -> kv1p5_mh@1, KLeak -> kleak_always_open@1, max_permeability = max Dm / tm, abundance 1, permeant K (1.0); availability 1 (0 in INIT for 'init active: false'); gates (m_inf, h_inf)(0 V) in INIT and (m_inf, h_inf)(Cells' INIT-end patch Vm) at the SIM handoff (BETSE re-reads the network at SIM start: an initial condition of the experiment)

discrimination_ratio.definition: the option's own effect (max over samples and phase end, interior ECM) divided by this protocol's tolerance, per phase and quantity (ion); ions at the 1e-12 floor (immobile P) are left out

non_discriminating_rule: Quantities listed here (ratio <= 1) are still judged, but the option's effect does not exceed their tolerance, so no claim about the option may rest on them.
status: REGISTERED L4 variant (lead, main, 11 November 2026, before any judged L4 run): numbers from the registered protocol's derivation plus measured Cells-vs-Cells backend terms; no L4 Cells-vs-BETSE difference has been computed. To be committed by the lead before any judged L4 run.
